en.title: Minimax M3.1 Flash: Free Preview Economics
en.titleCore: Minimax M3.1 Flash free preview economics
en.description: Minimax M3.1 Flash is free during preview. How to route to it, what it replaces, and how to fail over when pricing lands.
en.body:
What we know

  • Free preview on Minimax Code (duration unspecified)
  • Focus: speed + efficiency for daily coding tasks

Cost model: $0 during preview

During the free preview, M3.1 Flash is a $0 marginal cost model for supported workloads.

The catch: preview ends

Free previews are customer acquisition. When it ends, expect pricing in the $1-3 per 1M input / $5-15 per 1M output range.

faq.answer: Duration unspecified. Treat it as temporary.

faq.question: What is expected pricing after preview?
faq.answer: Unannounced. Flash models typically land at $1-3 input / $5-15 output per million tokens.
